title: Fuzzer: `Resource.set_path_cache` crashes Godot
body:
### Tested versions

- 4.8.dev.custom_build (2c089e9bf)

### System information

Ubuntu 26.04

### Issue description

### Steps to reproduce

Run this script:

```gdscript
extends Node

const _FRAMES_TARGET := 5
var _qf := 0

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	for i in get_children():
		i.queue_free()

	var temp_variable4464 = Resource.new()
	temp_variable4464.set_path("5555")
	temp_variable4464.set_path_cache("279579467")

	_qf += 1
	if _qf >= 5:
		get_tree().quit()
```

Or use the attached `mrp.zip`:

```
godot --headless --path mrp/ Node.tscn
```
